identity.name: KAIO BlackRock ICS US Dollar Liquidity Fund (CASHx)

about.description: CASHx is a tokenized feeder share class of Libre SAF VCC (Singapore) that invests in the BlackRock ICS US Dollar Liquidity Fund, an AAA-rated institutional money market fund. The accumulating token is issued via the KAIO (ex-Libre) protocol and is restricted to KYC-verified accredited and institutional investors, with NAV published on-chain via KAIO's registry on Optimism. Platform escrow balances are excluded from active supply. Smaller deployments on Avalanche, Aptos, Hedera, and Polygon currently carry zero or dust supply.
about.registryInfo: Tokenized shares of the underlying fund are issued solely by KAIO; the underlying is the BlackRock ICS US Dollar Liquidity Fund (Select Accumulating USD share class as referenced by KAIO).
